en.title: Season Two Blu-ray with Promo Card (PR-32)
en.description: LIVE ON EVERY TV. Hazbin Hotel Season Two on Blu-ray. 2-Disc Set featuring commentaries for all eight Season Two episodes with Creator Vivienne Medrano, Animation Director Skye Henwood, and Art Director Sam Miller. Each copy contains a fold-out poster, along with an exclusive promo card, Watch Party (PR-32) , for Hazbin Hotel Trading Cards .
